name: private-proxy
description: Task runner for the Private Proxy monorepo (extension + native helper). See README.md.

scripts.build: node scripts/cargo.mjs build && npm --prefix extension run build
scripts.build:release: node scripts/cargo.mjs build --release && npm --prefix extension run build:release
scripts.test: node scripts/cargo.mjs test && npm --prefix extension run typecheck && npm --prefix extension test
scripts.test:extension: npm --prefix extension run typecheck && npm --prefix extension test
